text:
Situation: Water for injection 1 mL/mL in 10 mL vials is low at all three Corvale sites. Corvale East has 8 vials (2.4 days), Corvale General has 46 vials (10.6 days), and Corvale Lakeside has 7 vials (9.7 days).

Why (FDA record): FDA's drug shortage list does not include water as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Supply is critically low at Corvale East and limited at the other sites. No FDA shortage is declared, so allocation restrictions do not apply. We must procure immediately using the ranked vendor list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer places purchase orders with American Regent, Inc. (first ranked option, not on FDA shortage list, plant VAI 2024-04-24). Requires buyer approval.
2. If American Regent cannot fulfill, buyer places orders with B. Braun Medical Inc. (second ranked option, not on FDA shortage list). Requires buyer approval.
3. If needed, buyer places orders with Civica, Inc. supplied from Hikma Pharmaceuticals USA Inc. (third ranked option, not on FDA shortage list, plant NAI 2026-05-13). Requires buyer approval.
4. Buyer monitors daily usage at all three sites and reports inventory to P&T committee weekly. Requires buyer and P&T chair approval.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending an FDA shortage listing; substituting sterile water with other diluents without clinician and committee review.
